_doc: Pi-IR projection of usage_merge/messages_sse.json — pi consumes the same SSE and emits a single text block. The token-usage merge invariant (input_tokens=100 + cache_read=50 + output_tokens=42 + thinking_tokens=15) lives on pi's output.usage, NOT in output_content[], and is locked by response_item_equiv.rs::golden_usage_merge_messages_completed_token_usage. Stage C locks the content-side projection so RI-032 is fenced from both directions: content IR (here) AND TokenUsage shape (response_item_equiv.rs).
